remarks: Live your best life high in the sky! Window-lined rooms offer Million-Dollar views from the cityscape all the way to Long Island Sound - and that's just the beginning! This exceptionally updated apartment features a contemporary open flow with beautiful new hardwood flooring & a designer white kitchen. Large bedroom with custom walk in closet & updated full bath complete this penthouse-inspired offering. Located in the heart of vibrant & sophisticated downtown Stamford, The Biltmore offers a first-class luxury experience featuring a full-time concierge, shuttle to the train station, state of the art fitness center & 4th floor green & dog walking park. Enjoy the city lights at night. Good credit a must, tenant to pay move-in/move-out fee. Parking available in the attached garage, $100.00/monthly.
